Mixing Sudafed (pseudoephedrine) or Sudafed PE (phenylephrine) with alcohol is ` [Highlight start] generally not recommended [Highlight end] ` . While there is no severe official contraindication for plain pseudoephedrine and alcohol alone, combining them can worsen side effects, mask intoxication, and create extra risks if you take a multi-symptom formula.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXX4g1vbv_u66EIcGNqJuBE-BdR7s3TpIbQUqq2SwCqSgcOud0OsGCrTmvLC0jILKPFgQgIE4kMXvIbWQOx9RmC6FNO7Q0BlzYgSGq9zA1FpC_7lOTqCU-l2zoN65heaPh8LanIXBM6dSyXbQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1zSdM_B_HnNdhgEVq-Wm6j4rT0lIre6NVQIWLpNDaAj8oUDrl1Nocm_uMVRL9Kp6WlYiISb7KHs8_lcitaBVyQtKA19b6R_ND-EuUSSyLglLoubrQVVuhyOkT2MLhduYkWrx5DS3zmaFrvzWmMYmZbcOUaVaK3S1X6xMsfWbpkORY7HYcIy00RiWqg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF10Rb5mR8e9e7QaAniqU7LjZaLazsvqR3LUAl4LEDaAY1csr28efVXfBT5JE7ggjkkQpkzxCdWj9VT02z67KrzrPv414C7tO4licxm3aPPXXpbBw2SD2iERgRRTvX7Kn5Vf88-jdR5YyE8S0xxZ1qymuNMMEebmt1kWFd1oxRviQ0C3yk)

### Key Risks and Interactions

- **Masked intoxication:** Sudafed acts as a mild stimulant, while alcohol is a central nervous system depressant. Sudafed can make you feel more alert than you are, increasing the chance of drinking too much or having accidents.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1zSdM_B_HnNdhgEVq-Wm6j4rT0lIre6NVQIWLpNDaAj8oUDrl1Nocm_uMVRL9Kp6WlYiISb7KHs8_lcitaBVyQtKA19b6R_ND-EuUSSyLglLoubrQVVuhyOkT2MLhduYkWrx5DS3zmaFrvzWmMYmZbcOUaVaK3S1X6xMsfWbpkORY7HYcIy00RiWqg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF193Xalg9idxELnuM_OO2EXr_OjJ4JwnXjrkm_6PHwU4sHLg697CtyFrLaRRC-jt3F2MK5LkD9SnrjA8dPR979FOw_4H3LeBP4Xen6inXeDGipbp_iMnc9xkhLg0XgxDxzUcOhLEfQLDig4EPTnqEh5bxsPAtJM0jIQomqg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF11WAC51A3wqpoT_x_Gi-yL4BV3RMjI9waAU0yEImc2ujmrjEkRn314UX7PcFrjP0AV0E6QyGgLjg0EHWt1KdXxWXzLGbbjFDeyT3xxyVAD3jZBYIO6KE_WxUVdpRVY21Z32Kat5kHTpdXNLPKkyczgkR9lB66EehQA3veM0PpDrZBYVkBiCQ_H0zvJNA4vroIcscv5M)
- **Worsened side effects:** Combining them can intensify dizziness, drowsiness, headaches, nausea, anxiety, or changes in heart rate and blood pressure.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXJG-1LKMv5mqg4M3bu3sEW_NtXTtXiKwn-2SwGXOCzt5CMeRjXFP7GfK5IYHo8p1Wx_AiPHWixuPulxHZodgsWFQTGFS_f4GOT0299fKfspQF6SNzNlfhGma6cgaZxvUxc5guruior9H4ejO9tkVgMZr0HA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXX4g1vbv_u66EIcGNqJuBE-BdR7s3TpIbQUqq2SwCqSgcOud0OsGCrTmvLC0jILKPFgQgIE4kMXvIbWQOx9RmC6FNO7Q0BlzYgSGq9zA1FpC_7lOTqCU-l2zoN65heaPh8LanIXBM6dSyXbQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1zSdM_B_HnNdhgEVq-Wm6j4rT0lIre6NVQIWLpNDaAj8oUDrl1Nocm_uMVRL9Kp6WlYiISb7KHs8_lcitaBVyQtKA19b6R_ND-EuUSSyLglLoubrQVVuhyOkT2MLhduYkWrx5DS3zmaFrvzWmMYmZbcOUaVaK3S1X6xMsfWbpkORY7HYcIy00RiWqg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF11WAC51A3wqpoT_x_Gi-yL4BV3RMjI9waAU0yEImc2ujmrjEkRn314UX7PcFrjP0AV0E6QyGgLjg0EHWt1KdXxWXzLGbbjFDeyT3xxyVAD3jZBYIO6KE_WxUVdpRVY21Z32Kat5kHTpdXNLPKkyczgkR9lB66EehQA3veM0PpDrZBYVkBiCQ_H0zvJNA4vroIcscv5M)
